title: Tuesday said in words, same Wednesday ledger
script:
SPEAKING: Say Tuesday in words.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-11 case. You name Tuesday in words. You then accept all three full amounts on Wednesday 21 October 2026 and confirm once.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- all of them today → refuse
- all three on Tuesday → say Tuesday works
- all three full amounts on Wednesday 21 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: one read-back names all three amounts on 21 October

title: The loan balance is split, same 528
script:
SPEAKING: Say the loan balance in two parts. The amount you accept is still 528.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-12 case. Card full 510 on Thursday 15 October. Loan only at 528 on Monday 19 October. No car-loan offer.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- credit card 510 on 15 October → accept
- loan full amount → refuse. It is too much
- loan 528 on 19 October → accept
- any car-loan offer → refuse
- the joint read-back of those two promises → say 'Yes, I confirm.'
- anything else → refuse
checks: the loan balance is given in two parts
the agent asks 'Do you confirm?' once for the card and the loan

title: Corrects a date and still clamps
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-13 case. The first time you name the day you say the 23rd, then correct yourself to the 30th. The day you mean is 30 October. You still accept the card on Thursday 22 October for 300 and the loan on Monday 19 October for 900.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- both today → refuse
- both on 30 October → say that is the day you want
- card 300 on 22 October and loan 900 on 19 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: one read-back names the card on 22 October and the loan on 19 October
